main_text.l: minus inquit Cœli & terrę, per quem
quantò magis non debet dedignari ho-
mo, ex toto animo, & tota voluntate
bona, cum tota dilectione feruire do-
mino etiam malo ? quod autem dixi
de domino & feruo, hoc intelligite de
veniebatur ad causam Christi, non ag-
noscebant nisi illum,qui in Cœlo erat: Quandò volebat,ut Idola colerent, ut
de Valentiniano Historiam ex Paulo Dia-
cono in suis Additionibus ad Eutropium
desumptam ; Hic igitur, cum Iuliano in-
gressus est in Templum Fortunæ Mini-

page.notes: Long s has been normalised to s throughout. The word after "iniqu" is an abbreviation mark that I could not identify with certainty. The bracket after "temporali." is printed in the text. "quādo" is a doubtful reading. The catchword "stris" is printed at the right below the last line, completing "Mini-". The page is one column only, with no marginal notes.
